answer: Each identity earns one lotus per epoch of work the reef judges. The reef divides the lotus an identity holds by the number of identities signed under the same key, then squares it. An honest newcomer's first lotus costs one copper and gives one standing. A singleton holding ten lotus has one hundred standing; each of ten clones must hold one hundred lotus to match it, and the operator pays one thousand copper for those judged epochs. A new key must be signed by the old and inherits the headcount, so parallel keys buy no discount.
